svg.title: Why a deadline requirement fails
svg.desc: A deadline requirement fails on a recorded trace, and the engineer asks why. The engineer sends F[0,3] p2 to tl-parse and gets a formula document, binds p2 to signal s2 with tl-syntax, and sends the document to tl-rewrite, which reports Unchanged under the closed-trace profile. tl-mltl evaluates the formula and trace and returns false at time 0 with a buffer of 4 instants, and R2U2, which runs outside the crates, returns false at time 0 for the C2PO expression F[0,3](p2). tl-oracle evaluates the same formula and trace independently and returns false. filament-mltl maps the result to Value false. Numbered observations mark where to look at each step.

g.data-text: Profile tl-family version 1Time domain: discrete stepsA recorded trace for the requirement F[0,3] p2.View scenario-sequence-view: positions 0 to 14 of 15.
3. status Unchanged under closed-trace: no rule applies, no step recorded; online-prefix has no rule set
5. a second evaluator reads the same formula and trace and returns false
6. false becomes Value false only if the observation views allow a value
2. p2 is bound to signal s2, the signal the requirement waits for
4. s2 is absent at instants 0 to 3, so false at time 0; R2U2 agrees
1. the tree is one F node, interval [0,3], over p2
[return] p2 bound to s2 (replies to go1)
tl-parse to engineer: [return] formula doc (replies to go0)
tl-syntax to engineer: [return] p2 bound to s2 (replies to go1)
tl-rewrite to engineer: [return] Unchanged (replies to go2)
tl-mltl to engineer: [return] false at 0, buffer 4 (replies to go3)
R2U2 to tl-mltl: [return] false at 0 (replies to go4)
engineer to tl-oracle (this crate): [async] formula + trace
tl-oracle (this crate) to engineer: [return] false (replies to go5)
filament-mltl to engineer: [return] Value false (replies to go6)
